decisions.summary: Separate captured HTTP responses from verified legal and business evidence.
decisions.concern: Avoid treating a successful HTTP request as document verification.
decisions.chosen_behavior: Verify legal document identity/version independently; keep applicability blocked and retain every attempt and manual provenance separately.
decisions.rationale: Capture alone cannot prove applicability or operational facts.
tradeoffs: Conservative classification requires later document review even for useful responses.
decisions.downstream_effect: No system facts, legal conclusions or approvals are generated.
